project: Golden Horn Retina Eye-Finding and Tracking AI
scope: Synthetic eye-image generation and pupil/eye tracking model; separate from retinal disease analysis; no motor commands
current_status: Planning specification complete; implementation not started
hardware_status: No target camera hardware or device-domain eye frames currently available
compute_recommendation: RTX 3050 Ti 4 GB is suitable for the initial compact-model prototype; L4 optional if throughput or memory becomes limiting

budget.status: No project-specific budget set; no cloud VM launched

gates.title: No target camera hardware yet
gates.detail: Development can use synthetic and terms-cleared public eye data. Device-specific performance cannot be established until camera footage and calibration exist.

gates.title: Synthetic-to-device domain gap
gates.detail: Synthetic validation is feasibility evidence only. The future sensor requires a held-out device-domain evaluation.

gates.title: Budget and compute authorization
gates.detail: No spend ceiling or new cloud authorization has been supplied for this separate project phase. No compute is running.

gates.title: Eye-tracking dataset terms
gates.detail: LPW is listed for non-commercial scientific use; check exact current terms for each public dataset before use.

blocks.name: Scope and software boundary
blocks.detail: Create a separate eye-tracking package. Do not modify retinal diagnosis or add motor commands.

blocks.name: Observation schema and coordinates
blocks.detail: Specify eye side, pupil mask/center, confidence, timestamp, track state, and calibration-gated stereo outputs.

blocks.name: Synthetic scene parameter envelope
blocks.detail: Define appearance, gaze, pupil, illumination, occlusion, camera, and motion ranges; identify assumptions.

blocks.name: Public eye-data and terms screen
blocks.detail: Check LPW, NVGaze, OpenEDS, label fit, access route, and exact terms before use.

blocks.name: Static eye-image generator
blocks.detail: Generate deterministic images with pixel masks, pupil centers, camera metadata, and seeds.

blocks.name: Temporal sequence generator
blocks.detail: Add motion, blinks, saccades, occlusion, and dropped-frame events with ground-truth tracks.

blocks.name: Generator label audit
blocks.detail: Verify labels against rendered geometry and inspect a visual sample sheet.

blocks.name: Leakage-safe data manifests
blocks.detail: Split by generated subject, eye, scene seed, and camera configuration.

blocks.name: Classical vision baseline
blocks.detail: Build threshold/contour/ellipse detector and measure errors by condition.

blocks.name: Compact model selection
blocks.detail: Choose pupil-segmentation model and resolution using training/validation only.

blocks.name: Training and checkpoint pipeline
blocks.detail: Create reproducible config, resume, checkpoint, and loss logging.

blocks.name: First synthetic model training
blocks.detail: Train compact segmentation candidate; select checkpoint on validation only.

blocks.name: Frame-level detector evaluation
blocks.detail: Report center/mask accuracy, detections, false detections, and confidence calibration.

blocks.name: Temporal tracking and eye identity
blocks.detail: Track both eyes through blinks, brief occlusions, and identity changes.

blocks.name: Simulated stereo geometry
blocks.detail: Triangulate only with known synthetic calibration; reject invalid depth and measure reprojection error.

blocks.name: Confidence and unknown-state behavior
blocks.detail: Emit lost/uncertain state when eye evidence is insufficient.

blocks.name: Domain-randomization ablation
blocks.detail: Compare matched training with and without randomization groups.

blocks.name: Public IR benchmark evaluation
blocks.detail: Evaluate on subject-held-out data only when terms and label compatibility are verified.

blocks.name: Permitted-data adaptation
blocks.detail: Adapt using development data only; preserve source tags and keep test data untouched.

blocks.name: Runtime profiling
blocks.detail: Measure latency, memory, and throughput on the selected compute target.

blocks.name: Integration contract
blocks.detail: Publish observations/status to a separate controller interface; no motor commands.

blocks.name: Synthetic failure stress tests
blocks.detail: Exercise occlusion, blur, light shifts, out-of-frame eyes, camera mismatch, and timestamp gaps.

blocks.name: Freeze and locked evaluation
blocks.detail: Freeze model/config and run one held-out evaluation with uncertainty and failure breakdowns.

blocks.name: Package and hardware handoff
blocks.detail: Package model, manifests, report, model card, and future camera-calibration/data requirements.
